items.title: Aebersold Jamey — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: And my older brother, when he was playing piano (and then I was playing, too, I guess), we worked up a couple of duets.

ctx.x: Yeah, little etudes. And my older brother, when he was playing piano (and then I was playing, too, I guess), we worked up a couple of duets. “Bicycle Built For Two.” We’d play at a church. Then another church asked us to come out on Sunday morning, and we’d go over there and play. I remember doing that. That was fun. But I just couldn’t see where we were going with practicing the scales and stuff. If she’d had me improvise, I’d still be playing the piano.
